other_conditions: Must have passed Standard 12 with at least 60% marks from any school in Gujarat
Must be pursuing an undergraduate or postgraduate professional course accredited by the relevant councils
Must be studying in Gujarat or in other states/UTs for select institutions such as IIM, IIT, NID, NIFT, IRMA, and TISS
Priority is given to widows and orphans when sanctioning loans
Loans will be recovered without interest subsidy if the borrower drops out or fails to obtain the degree within the stipulated time
benefits_summary: Provides education loans up to ₹10,00,000 (or the full tuition fee, whichever is lower) at a simple interest rate of 4% for eligible students.
